label: Cart
description: Basic shop cart (badge + popup). Site modules extend for design.

settings.name: cart_label
settings.label: Cart
settings.help: Menu badge text. Use {{number}} for the live item count.

settings.name: cart_label_mobile
settings.label: Cart (mobile)
settings.help: Badge on small screens. Use {{number}} for the live item count. Empty uses Cart.

settings.name: note
settings.label: Note
settings.help: Shown above the bottom line of the cart popup. Leave empty to hide.

settings.name: unavailable_item_warning
settings.label: Item not available
settings.help: Shown on a cart line when its stock is gone. {{item}} is the product with its options, e.g. Poster (A3, Black).

settings.name: price_changed_notice
settings.label: Price changed
settings.help: Shown on a cart line when its price was updated to the current price (cart opened or Checkout clicked).

settings.name: add_error
settings.label: Add failed
settings.help: Shown when adding to the cart fails without a more specific error.

settings.name: checkout_error
settings.label: Checkout failed
settings.help: Shown when the checkout provider returns no redirect and no error.

settings.name: checkout_missing_error
settings.label: No checkout provider
settings.help: Shown under Checkout when Shop settings has no checkout provider.
